title: Analysis code for laboratory-reported versus CLSI M100 2022 AST phenotypes (ARMD-MGB)
description: Python analysis code and non-identifiable aggregate tables and figures comparing laboratory-reported antimicrobial susceptibility categories with CLSI M100 2022 interpretations of the same recorded MIC or zone in ARMD-MGB v1.0.0. Patient-level data are not included.
